- **Rates versus credit.** The 10Y has eased to 4.894%, which normally helps growth stocks. Credit spreads are widening at the same time (HY 3.44%, IG 0.94%). Credit is the more worrying signal.
- **VXN versus VIX.** VXN is 30.89 against VIX 21.41. Stress is concentrated in Nasdaq names, which is the market TQQQ tracks.
- **Option pricing is slightly better for sellers.** IV/HV is 1.19 (options cost about 19% more than the stock actually moved over 20 days). That is up from 1.03 last read, but it is still a thin cushion.
